svg.aria-label: Animated diagram: you enter income, expenses and debts in the Next.js app, a deterministic finance engine calculates cash flow, protected budget and payoff, forecast, decision, memory and reminder services build on it, data goes through a repository boundary to PostgreSQL when self-hosted or per-tab browser memory in the public demo, and a minimized context goes through the AI provider registry so the AI Coach can explain the results without changing them
svg.title: How Atlas AI works
svg.text: The finance engine calculates; the AI Coach only explains

g.text: You enter income, expenses and debts
A deterministic engine does every calculation: cash flow, protected budget, payoff
Forecasts, scenarios, memory snapshots and reminders build on those numbers
Self-hosted: data goes through one repository boundary into PostgreSQL
Public demo: the same boundary keeps fictional data in tab memory, gone on refresh
The Coach gets a minimized context: only the fields an explanation needs
Mock AI in the demo; your own key or a local model (Ollama, LM Studio) when self-hosted
The answer is validated and explains the numbers. It never changes them
